verdict.rationale: AutoGen Studio's docs say you can export and run teams in Python, set up and test endpoints from a team configuration, and run teams in a Docker container. That covers exposing an agent as an API endpoint, but only as a self-hosted deployment rather than a managed runtime. Missing for 10: a vendor-managed or hosted runtime for deploying agents, detailed documentation of the endpoint/API surface (auth, scaling, invocation), and independent or hands-on corroboration of production endpoint deployment.
